# fct_booking_attribution

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_booking_attribution` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Attributes bookings to Portal features. One row per booking. Join to fct_bookings on booking_id for TTV and other booking details. A booking can be attributed to multiple features simultaneously via boolean flags. Attribution logic by feature: - bookable_quotes: Booking was made through a bookable quote (direct link via quote ID, no time window). - client_portal: Booking was made directly through the Client Portal, or the client viewed a supplier's property details page in the Client Portal and the advisor booked that client at the same supplier within 7 days. - deals: Advisor clicked a deal (on deals page or partner details page), then booked at the same supplier within 7/14/21/28 days, during the deal's valid booking and travel date windows. Attributed to the most recent click. - rebooking: Advisor made multiple bookings for the same client + supplier + travel dates, at least one was cancelled. Use rebooking_type to see if the rebooked price has changed (Rebooked at Lower Price / Rebooked at Higher Price / Rebooked at Same Price). Filter has_price_drop_email = true to see only rebookings confirmed by a Customer.io price drop email. - via: Booking's supplier was recommended by Via to the same advisor within 7 days before the booking, or the booking's trip was created by Via, has a published Via-authored proposal itinerary, or the client was created by Via. Use is_attributable_to_via for any method, or the individual is_attributable_to_via_* flags for a specific one.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Primary key — one row per booking. Foreign key to fct_bookings >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `attributed_deal_id` | Foreign key to supplier_deals. Populated when is_attributed_to_deals = true >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `attributed_quote_id` | Foreign key to bookable_quotes. Populated when is_attributed_to_bookable_quotes = true >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `attributed_via_supplier_return_key` | Foreign key to fct_via_supplier_returns. Populated when is_attributable_to_via_supplier_recommendation_7d = true >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `bookable_quotes_days_from_interaction_to_booking` | Days between bookable quote creation and booking creation >> SOURCE - Calculated |
| `bookable_quotes_interaction_at` | When the bookable quote was created >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_portal_attribution_type` | How the booking is attributed to the Client Portal — direct (booked in the portal itself) or indirect (client viewed a property details page for the same supplier, advisor booked within 7 days; excludes bookings already counted as direct, so the two are mutually exclusive). Null if not attributed to the Client Portal >> SOURCE - Portal / Segment |
| `client_portal_indirect_days_from_interaction_to_booking` | Days between the client's property details page view in the Client Portal and the advisor's booking at that supplier >> SOURCE - Calculated |
